## Motivation

- One source, two outputs: `plasma-revealjs` (HTML) and `plasma-beamer` (PDF)
- Text, lists and maths are plain Quarto Markdown
- Figures from plasma-plots: interactive in HTML, a PDF in Beamer

## An equation

The speeds of particles of mass $m$ in a plasma at temperature $T$:

$$
f(v) \propto v^2 \exp\left(-\frac{m v^2}{2 k_B T}\right)
$$

## Figures

Save a figure with `plasma_presentations.figure(result, "figures/growth")` and show it with

```markdown
{{{< plasma-figure figures/growth caption="Growth rate" >}}}
```
